items.excerpt: Meta is rolling out Pocket to US users after a Brazil test: an app where anyone prompts small interactive games — 'gizmos' that respond to touch, tilt and sound — into a scrollable, remixable feed. Text-to-game creation as a consumer social format, with the acquired Gizmo app being shut down in its favour.

A newly surfaced Sony patent describes an AI agent trained on your own play data that can grind or replay sections for you — and a marketplace where players could sell that behavioural data to train it. It reframes player modelling from a tuning tool into a designed, monetised game system.

The GTA 6 leak wave has been flooded with convincing AI-generated fakes, to the point that players can no longer tell real footage from synthetic. A working problem for anyone shipping marketing assets: authenticity of a studio's own visuals is now contested by default.

Final Fantasy: Crystal Chronicles composer Kumi Tanioka says an AI-generated album published under her name on Spotify is not hers, and her label Digital Sonic Design has issued a statement. Game credits and artist identity are leaking into generative distribution pipelines with no verification layer.

Blue Archive creator Kim Yong-ha's packed BIC 2026 keynote asked how a game becomes a 'world', arguing that in the AI era the one thing only humans hold is the aesthetic judgement that decides what belongs in that world. Includes a short interview alongside the talk.

Former PlayStation Studios boss Shuhei Yoshida says he is both fascinated and worried by AI's spread through development, and expects a 'tough future' for the craft. A veteran read on what AI adoption does to the pipeline rather than to the balance sheet.

Take-Two's former AI lead has turned skeptic, arguing that if the tools really did what vendors claim, nobody would be selling them: 'they would not be talking about it.' An insider's deflation of the game-AI tooling pitch.

SpiralAI has postponed RyzaChat, a Koei Tecmo-licensed app that lets players co-write a summer story with an LLM-driven Ryza, to reinforce server capacity. A licensed AI-character product hitting the runtime-cost wall before launch.

With anti-AI clauses now appearing in standard game contracts and studios pulling gen-AI assets after review bombs, GamesRadar argues player backlash is measurably changing what publishers let teams ship. The constraint has moved from ethics debate into production requirements.

An argument against the executive case for generative NPCs and AI-written dialogue: the value of game writing sits in authored detail that infinite generated lines cannot fake. 'The delight's in the details.'

A survey of 100 Gamescom Dev Conference speakers finds developers expect generative AI to reshape roles and team sizes within three years, while remaining hesitant and split on using it. Org-chart consequences, stated by the people who will live with them.

Unreal MCP is now available in Unreal Editor for Fortnite. UEFN evangelist Magnus Enebakk walks through Model Context Protocol in UEFN and how agentic coding tools can drive island creation directly inside the editor.

Unity ships a CLI installable in one terminal command, with a Pipeline package that 'opens the Editor to the outside world' — listing commands, managing Play mode, running tests and executing C# in a live Editor instance. The control surface external agents and scripts need.
